justification: Both depict a striding anthropomorphic figure with a non-human/masked head, an elaborate crown topped or flanked by disc motifs, holding an upright staff-like object in a raised forward arm, which is a fairly specific shared configuration. However, A is a two-figure confrontational scene with registers of script signs and a winged sun-disc framing device, rendered in flat, restrained low-relief profile convention, whereas B is a single large winged figure with heavy layered ornament, feathers and banded skirt drawn in bold curvilinear outline with no accompanying text or second figure.
